## Description and Rationale

I am an independent data science enthusiast .
I am interested in machine learning, data analysis, and practical applications of predictive modeling.
I decided to participate in the PRC Data Challenge to improve my data science skills by working with real-world aviation data and to learn more about applying machine learning to air traffic management problems.
